powers.title: Absorb Storm
powers.description: You channel the power of the storm to bolster yourself against an attack and divert the power to your next assault.
rows: Trigger: You take cold, lightning, or thunder damage

Effect: Until the end of the encounter, you gain resistance to the triggering damage type equal to your Charisma. Your next attack before the end of the encounter that deals the triggering damage type gains a +2 bonus to the attack roll.

powers.title: Deep Shroud
powers.description: You raise and then lower your hands, creating an obscuring shadow that cloaks you and the area around you.
rows: Effect: You create a shroud of supernatural shadow around you. Until the end of your next turn, the space you occupy and each square adjacent to you are heavily obscured.
Sustain Minor: The effect persists.

powers.title: Dragonflame Mantle
powers.description: You ward yourself with a mantle of flame.
rows: Trigger: You are hit by an attack
Effect: Until the end of your next turn, you gain a +1 power bonus to all defenses, and any creature that hits you with a melee attack takes 1d6 fire damage.

powers.title: Elemental Shift
powers.description: The alignment of elements within you changes at your command.
rows: Effect: You can change the resistance granted by your Dragon Soul or Wild Soul to one of the other damage types for the rest of the encounter. In addition, one ally adjacent to you gains resist 5 to the damage type that you resist until the end of the encounter.
Level 11: Resist 10.
Level 21: Resist 15.

powers.title: Focused Chaos
powers.description: To make chaos work for you, you must exercise a bit of control, but not too much. On your next spell, you manage to achieve the outcome you desire.
rows: Trigger: You use a sorcerer power that works differently depending on whether the attack roll is odd or even
Effect: You choose to treat that power's attack roll as either odd or even, regardless of your actual roll.

powers.title: Gambling Siphon
powers.description: You manipulate the chaos of battle surrounding an ally and transfer some of their luck to you.
rows: Trigger: An ally within 10 squares makes an attack.

Effect: Before the ally makes his or her first attack roll for the triggering attack, choose 1–10 or 11–20. If the result on the die for the attack roll of the triggering attack is within the range selected, you gain a +5 power bonus to damage rolls until the end of your next turn. Otherwise, you gain a +2 power bonus to damage rolls until the end of your next turn.

powers.title: Good Timing
powers.description: You must have been in the right place at the right time.
rows: Trigger: You miss a target with a sorcerer attack power.

Effect: Reroll the triggering attack roll. If you still miss the target even after the reroll, you take psychic damage equal to your Charisma and regain the use of this power at the start of your next turn.

powers.title: Rock Armor
powers.description: You shield yourself with armor shaped from the rock, pebbles, and earth around you.
rows: Effect: You assume the rock armor stance. Until the stance ends, you are slowed and gain resistance to all damage equal to your Charisma.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Elemental Chaos, page(s) 92.

powers.title: Shield of Flames
powers.description: You conjure a sphere of blazing hot flames, obscuring your form and damaging enemies who tarry too close.
rows: Effect: You activate an aura 1 that lasts until the end of your next turn. You have partial concealment against enemies in the aura, and any creature that makes a melee attack against you or ends its turn in the aura takes fire damage equal to your Charisma. A creature can take this damage only once per turn.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Elemental Chaos, page(s) 92.

powers.title: Sorcerous Sirocco
powers.description: You exhale a magic-enhanced breath that briefly sends you and an ally flying through the air.
rows: Target: You and one ally in the burst
Effect: Each target moves a number of squares equal to his or her speed + 2. Each target can fly during this movement but falls if he or she does not land by the end of the movement.

powers.title: Spatial Trip
powers.description: You spin around, releasing a blaze of golden energy. As you finish your revolution, you disappear and reappear a short distance away.
rows: Effect: You teleport a number of squares equal to half your speed.

powers.title: Stretch Spell
powers.description: You bend space to increase the extent of your spell.
rows: Effect: Until the end of your turn, add your Dexterity to the range of your ranged arcane powers.

powers.title: Unseen Aid
powers.description: Invisible forces aid you in mysterious ways.
rows: Effect: You gain a +2 bonus to a skill check you make this turn.

powers.title: Wall of Water
powers.description: You shape water into a foot-thick vertical wall that interferes with attacks and movement for a short time.
rows: Effect: You create a wall of water that lasts until the end of your next turn. The wall provides superior cover against attacks made through it. A creature must swim to move through the wall (Athletics DC 10). In addition, a creature passing through the wall gains vulnerable 5 cold until the end of its next turn.
Sustain Minor: The wall persists until the end of your next turn.
Special: If any part of the wall meets an area of liquid water at least 5 squares in size, you can increase the area to a wall 10.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Elemental Chaos, page(s) 92.

powers.title: Whirling Wind
powers.description: Whirling air surrounds you, protecting you and obscuring your position.
rows: Effect: The burst creates a zone of lightly obscured squares that lasts until the end of your next turn. Creatures in the zone must spend 1 extra square for each square of movement toward you.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Elemental Chaos, page(s) 92.

powers.title: Arcane Empowerment
powers.description: You force additional energy into your spells.
rows: Effect: Until the end of your turn, increase the size of your arcane powers' blasts and bursts by 1.

powers.title: Chaos Wager
powers.description: “Let's take a chance—I' ve got a good feeling about this one.”
rows: Trigger: An ally within 5 squares makes an attack.

Effect: Before the ally makes his or her first attack roll for the triggering attack, choose 1–10 or 11–20. If the result on the die for the attack roll of the triggering attack is within the range selected, you gain a power bonus to damage rolls against that target equal to 5 + your Charisma until the end of your next turn.

powers.title: Chaotic Defense
powers.description: You create a din of chaotic sounds, from a wolf 's forlorn howl to a dead sailor's dirge. In the cacophony, you find temporary aid.
rows: Effect: Roll a d4 to determine the power's effect.
1: You gain temporary hit points equal to 2d6 + your Charisma.
2: You gain a +2 power bonus to all defenses until the end of the encounter.
3: Until the end of the encounter, each creature that attacks you takes 2d6 damage.
4: You gain all three of the benefits described above.

powers.title: Energetic Flight
powers.description: You hurtle forward on wings shaped from streamers of dancing energy.
rows: Effect: Until the end of your next turn, you gain a fly speed equal to your speed, and you can hover.

powers.title: Extinguishing Rain
powers.description: Clouds emerge from your body, saturating the air. Fires no longer threaten you, and nearby flames are dampened.
rows: Target: You and each ally in the burst
Effect: Until the end of the encounter, each target gains resistance to fire equal to your Charisma. Make an attack.
Target: One conjuration or zone that has the fire keyword
Attack: Charisma + 2 vs. the Will of the target's creator
Hit: The target is destroyed. All its effects end, including those that a save can end.

powers.title: Fate's Chaos
powers.description: You tweak the course of fate, turning ill luck into good fortune.
rows: Trigger: You spend an action point to make an attack and miss
Effect: Reroll the triggering attack roll with a bonus equal to your Strength.

powers.title: Fire Stride
powers.description: You step into a blazing fire and instantly teleport to another nearby fire without harm.
rows: Requirement: You must be adjacent to a fire of campfire size or larger.
Effect: You teleport up to 10 squares to a square adjacent to a fire of campfire size or larger.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Elemental Chaos, page(s) 93.

powers.title: Lightning Shift
powers.description: With a flourish of snapping sparks, your single step speeds you, lightning-quick, across the battlefield.
rows: Effect: You shift your speed. You ignore difficult terrain during the shift.

powers.title: Raise Stone
powers.description: You raise or lower a column of rock from the ground.
rows: Target: One square of stone, mud, or dirt

Effect: You cause the target square to rise up to 20 feet or sink up to 10 feet. If you raise the square, the area below it is filled with solid rock and becomes blocking terrain. Creatures in the target square can shift 1 square as a free action to avoid being raised or lowered. This power cannot be used to harm a creature, and any such use causes the power to fail. The target square remains at its new elevation until the end of the encounter.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Elemental Chaos, page(s) 92.

powers.title: Subtlety of the Green Wyrm
powers.description: You listen for the faint whisper of your own blood. In its flow, you find ancient wisdom and unrivaled charm.
rows: Effect: You gain a +5 power bonus to Diplomacy checks, Insight checks, and Intimidate checks until the end of the encounter.

powers.title: Sudden Scales
powers.description: Dragon scales cover your form in reaction to an assault, as arcane power shields your mind and body from harm.
rows: Trigger: You are hit by an attack
Effect: You gain a +4 bonus to all defenses against the triggering attack.
Dragon Magic: The bonus to all defenses equals 3 + your Strength.

powers.title: Swift Escape
powers.description: A quick reaction saves you from the explosion.
rows: Trigger: You are hit by an area or a close attack
Effect: You teleport 3 squares.
Wild Magic: The number of squares you teleport equals 2 + your Dexterity.

powers.title: Water to Ice
powers.description: Using cold to directly harm your enemies is one thing. You can also turn it to your advantage by using cold against water, freezing the area around you.
rows: Effect: You cause nonliving water in the burst to freeze to a depth of 6 inches. Mud or swamp freezes, becoming normal terrain. Wet floors change to slick ice, becoming difficult terrain. Ice covers bodies of water in the area, which can now be walked on (although the ice is difficult terrain). A creature that enters a square of this ice or starts its turn there must make a DC 11 Acrobatics check or fall prone. The transformed ice remains frozen until it melts naturally.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Elemental Chaos, page(s) 93.

powers.title: Wind Rider
powers.description: Powerful winds bear you aloft by pushing against the ground beneath you.
rows: Effect: Until the end of your next turn, you can fly up to your speed as a move action (altitude limit 4). You grant combat advantage while aloft.
Sustain Standard: The effect persists until the end of your next turn.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Elemental Chaos, page(s) 93.

powers.title: Chaos Link
powers.description: You bend the fabric of reality to bind an enemy's fate to yours.
rows: Trigger: You are hit by an area or a close attack
Target: One creature in the burst
Effect: The triggering attack also hits the target.

powers.title: Control Flame
powers.description: You command a fire to burn more fiercely, or move it to a new location.
rows: Effect: You take control of each nonliving fire in the burst that is not controlled by a creature. Choose one of the following options for each fire.
Expand: The fire expands to a square adjacent to it.
Extinguish: The fire is extinguished.
Relocate: You move the fire up to 2 squares.
Expanded or relocated flames return to their normal size and location at the end of your next turn.
Sustain Minor: The effect persists until the end of your next turn, and you can expand, extinguish, or relocate the controlled flames again.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Elemental Chaos, page(s) 93.

powers.title: Devour Magic
powers.description: You consume lingering magic to empower your own.
rows: Target: One conjuration or zone
Attack: Charisma + 2 vs. the Will of the target's creator
Hit: The target is destroyed. All its effects end, including those that a save can end.
Dragon Magic: You gain the bonus from your Scales of the Dragon, whether or not you're bloodied.
Wild Magic: Until the end of the encounter, the first time you attack during each of your turns, you can choose your Chaos Burst benefit, instead of having your attack roll determine it.

powers.title: Dragon's Resolve
powers.description: Your blood boils with the wrath of a dragon, giving you greater fury and power when the situation seems most dire.
rows: Effect: Until the end of the encounter, while you are bloodied, you gain a +1 power bonus to attack rolls and a power bonus to saving throws equal to your Charisma.

powers.title: Earth Passage
powers.description: You stride through earth or stone as if it isn't there.
rows: Effect: You move up to your speed. During this movement, you can pass through stone, rock, sand, or earth, and you have tremorsense 1. If you end this movement inside solid earth, you immediately move to an unoccupied square nearest your entry point.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Elemental Chaos, page(s) 93.

powers.title: Elemental Shield
powers.description: You block a dangerous manifestation of the elements with an immediate counterspell, protecting yourself and your allies.
rows: Trigger: You or an ally within 2 squares of you takes acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage.
Target: You and each ally in the burst
Effect: Until the end of your next turn, each target gains resist 10 to the triggering damage type.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Elemental Chaos, page(s) 93.

powers.title: Elemental Warding
powers.description: You ward an area with seething elemental power.
rows: Target: One, two, or three squares in the burst

Effect: Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. Each target square becomes a zone that lasts until the end of the encounter. You or an ally gains resist 10 to damage of the chosen type while in the zone.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Elemental Chaos, page(s) 94.

powers.title: Fog Form
powers.description: In an instant, your body melts into a cloud of fog.
rows: Trigger: You are hit by an attack
Effect: You become insubstantial until the end of your next turn.

powers.title: Invert Resistance
powers.description: You twist the nature of your foes to turn their protection into a weakness.
rows: Target: Each enemy in the burst
Effect: Each target loses its resistances and gains vulnerable 5 to the damage types it had resistance against (save ends both).

powers.title: Maiden's Waking
powers.description: The Maiden of the Moon rouses you from your languor.
rows: Trigger: You start your turn stunned, dazed, or unconscious
Effect: You take your turn as though you were not stunned, dazed, or unconscious. At the end of your turn, the effect continues as normal.

powers.title: Narrow Escape
powers.description: You teleport away from your foe and reduce the force of its attack.
rows: Trigger: You are hit by an attack
Effect: You take half damage from the attack. You then teleport a number of squares equal to your Charisma + your Dexterity.

powers.title: Sorcerous Pulse
powers.description: You drown out the clash of combat and focus on one type of energy, which you channel into your spells for extra power.
rows: Effect: Choose acid, cold, fire, force, lightning, necrotic, poison, psychic, radiant, or thunder. Until the end of the encounter, whenever you use an arcane power that has the chosen keyword, you can roll the damage twice and use the higher result.

powers.title: Spirit's Eclipse
powers.description: A mental bulwark helps to protect you against your foe's attack and renders the creature incapable of seeing you for a time.
rows: Trigger: An enemy hits you with an attack that targets Will
Effect: Until the end of your next turn, you gain a +5 bonus to Will and are invisible to the triggering enemy.

powers.title: Storm of Energy
powers.description: With a wave of your hand, you increase the vigor of whatever effects ail your foes.
rows: Target: Each enemy in the burst that is taking ongoing damage
Effect: Each instance of ongong damage that each target is taking increases by 10.

powers.title: Weave Luck
powers.description: Chaos intervenes all around, creating good luck for you and misfortune for your enemies.
rows: Effect: Until the end of the encounter, when you miss an enemy with an attack roll, you gain one of the following benefits: If the result of the die is even, you slide the target 1 square as a free action. If the result on the die is odd, you gain a +2 power bonus to your next attack roll made against that target before the end of your next turn.
